name: SpecialCase
summary: A subclass that stands for a particular case, and behaves so that callers need no test for it.

roles.name: SpecialCase
roles.summary: A case given a type of its own — an unknown customer, a missing rate, a job with no operator — so that the condition is handled by the type system instead of by a test at every call site. What makes it the pattern rather than a subclass is that callers do not distinguish it: it answers the same protocol, with answers appropriate to its case.
